Watts made this hymn from Psalm 36:5–9, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

5Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds. 6Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast. 7How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings! 8They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights. 9For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light. PSALM 36:5–9 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 36
High in the heav'ns, eternal God, Thy goodness in full glory shines Thy truth shall break through every cloud That veils and darkens thy designs. STANZA I
